items.text: The NIFTY 500 rose 0.1% on 16 Nov. Financial Services was the strongest sector (−0.6%) and Power the weakest (−2.2%).

Foreign investors bought a net ₹5,565 Cr of Indian shares in the session reported on 16 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 53 niches; Retail & Discount Brokers, Staffing & HR Services and Gas Transmission & LNG and others joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Large PSU Banks, Travel Services & Railways Catering and Healthcare IT & Admin Services.
